assessments.title: The Price Watch Bulletin: From Spreadsheet Export to Tidy Data
assessments.summary: Reshape a print-formatted, multi-table state food price bulletin (merged headers, page breaks, footnote notation, summary rows) into tested tidy data, then recompute every published average to discover how the national figure is really built and which averages are inconsistent.
competencies: Reading irregular files without loss
Validating string parsers that fail loudly
Reshaping wide multi-header tables into tidy long data
Correct use of melt, merge, groupby and concat with row-count checks
Calendar-aware period arithmetic
Reconciling published aggregates with their inputs (mean of means vs pooled mean)
Unit testing of data-wrangling code

assessments.title: The Ledger That Double-Counts: Debugging a Mobile-Money Settlement Pipeline
assessments.summary: A legacy POS agent-banking settlement script runs cleanly but pays the wrong commission. Find every defect against its docstring specification, prove each with a failing test, fix it, reconcile with the switch's control totals, and measure what each defect cost.
competencies: Reading code against a written specification
Minimal reproducing examples and regression tests
Join cardinality, fan-out and effective-dated lookups
Deduplication on a business key with latest-message semantics
Time-zone-correct business dates
pandas copy semantics and chained assignment
Impact measurement of interacting defects
Reconciliation against independent control totals

assessments.title: Rain Onset at Scale: Vectorising an Agro-Climate Pipeline Without Changing Its Answers
assessments.summary: Profile a correct but loop-bound rainfall pipeline (monthly totals, dry spells, agronomic onset dates, anomalies), re-implement it with NumPy and pandas, prove equivalence against the legacy oracle on adversarial inputs, and measure the speed-up with a fair benchmark protocol.
competencies: Profiling Python code to find bottlenecks
Vectorisation with masks, cumulative sums and run-length encoding
Complete-calendar reindexing of gappy time series
Preserving NaN, boundary and dtype semantics
Equivalence testing against an oracle with randomised inputs
Fair benchmarking of time and memory

compute.notes: 8 GB is needed only for the full-size benchmark (about 4.3M rows); a free Google Colab or Kaggle notebook is a valid alternative for that step. Everything else runs in 4 GB.

assessments.title: Every Page, Exactly Once: A Resilient Client for the World Bank Indicators API
assessments.summary: Build a paginated World Bank API client with retries, jittered backoff, an integrity-checked cache and a provenance log. It must survive the API's real traps (HTTP-200 errors, nulls, republished vintages) and is tested fully offline against recorded responses and a fault-injecting fake server.
competencies: Paginated API acquisition with completeness guarantees
Classifying transient and permanent failures
Exponential backoff with full jitter and Retry-After
Canonical, atomic, integrity-checked caching
Provenance logging and data-vintage awareness
Testing network code offline with injected transports, clocks and sleeps

compute.notes: Internet is needed only for one short live run (deliverable 3). All tests run offline.

assessments.title: Four Agencies, One Price: Parsing and Reconciling Heterogeneous Food-Price Files
assessments.summary: Parse JSON, XML, a multi-sheet Excel workbook and a legacy fixed-width file describing the same staple-food prices into one canonical table. Then classify each surviving cross-agency anomaly as a parsing error, a source defect or a real market event, with evidence.
competencies: Parsing JSON, XML, Excel and fixed-width formats
Unit, currency and time-key normalisation with reference tables
Explicit missingness and revision handling
Robust cross-source reconciliation and stale-value detection
Classifying anomalies as parsing errors, source defects or real events

assessments.title: The Registry That Lies: Forensic Cleaning of a Student Records Export
assessments.summary: Profile and clean a deliberately corrupted university registry export. Recover what can be recovered, flag what cannot, consolidate duplicates without merging namesakes, and detect a hidden systemic grading-scale defect from data.
competencies: Systematic data profiling and defect inventory
Distinguishing missing, invalid, ambiguous and valid values
Canonicalisation of categorical values with auditable mappings
Parsing heterogeneous date and phone formats without guessing
Rule-based duplicate detection with false-merge awareness
Detecting systemic (non-random) defects from distributions
Unit testing of data-cleaning rules
Data-quality reporting for non-technical owners

assessments.title: Bags, Basins and Tonnes: Harmonising a Smallholder Harvest Survey
assessments.summary: Convert a smallholder harvest survey recorded in bags, basins, mudus and tonnes to kilograms with crop-specific factors and uncertainty bounds, flag implausible yields with robust rules, and investigate how much each cleaning decision changes the production total.
competencies: Unit-of-measure harmonisation with auditable mappings
Conversion with crop-specific factors and uncertainty bounds
Robust outlier rules (MAD modified z-score, Tukey IQR) on an appropriate scale
Domain-limit plausibility checks
Separating implausible values from unusual but genuine ones
Quantifying the sensitivity of totals to cleaning decisions
Investigating the source of systematic data-collection errors

assessments.title: Stuck, Drifting, Spiking: Validation Rules for a Low-Cost Air-Quality Network
assessments.summary: Implement exactly specified validation rules for five low-cost PM2.5/temperature/humidity monitors in Lagos: range, stuck-value and Hampel spike checks, robust clock-drift estimation, gap detection, a bitmask quality-flag scheme and completeness-aware hourly means.
competencies: Implementing time-series validation rules exactly to specification
Robust spike detection with the Hampel rule
Run-length detection of stuck sensors
Robust clock offset and drift estimation (Theil-Sen)
Distinguishing late uploads from clock faults
Designing and applying a bitmask quality-flag scheme
Completeness rules for aggregated data

assessments.title: The Paradox Ward: Stratified Exploration of Hospital Outcome Rankings
assessments.summary: A draft hospital league table ranks the network's referral centre last on crude 30-day mortality. Stratify, standardise and decompose the rates to discover a Simpson's reversal, tell confounders from proxies and non-confounders, and advise the Commissioner on what the data can and cannot show.
competencies: Building stratified rate tables with binomial uncertainty
Diagnosing case-mix (composition) differences between groups
Detecting and explaining Simpson's paradox systematically
Direct standardisation and Kitagawa rate-gap decomposition
Distinguishing confounders, proxies and non-confounders with evidence
Writing quantified, limitation-aware findings for a decision-maker

assessments.title: Hours on the Feeder: Supply-Hours Exploration of Electricity Outage Logs
assessments.summary: Turn six months of messy control-room outage logs from a fictional Nigerian distribution company into defensible daily supply hours, then use dependence-aware bootstrap intervals to find which feeders are confidently failing their NERC service band and how naive processing distorts the answer.
competencies: Converting event logs into regular time series with interval arithmetic
Detecting logging artefacts and representing missing coverage explicitly
Block and cluster bootstrap intervals under dependence
Answering stakeholder questions with quantified uncertainty
Testing data transformations with hand-worked edge cases

assessments.title: The Confident Notebook: Auditing the Claims of an Exploratory Analysis
assessments.summary: Audit a polished but flawed exploratory notebook from a fictional mobile-money operator. For each of ten claims, decide whether the data supports it, name the flaw (survivorship, base rates, log scales, confounding, ecological fallacy, regression to the mean and more) and compute the correct figure.
competencies: Separating correct computation from flawed inference in an analysis
Recognising and naming common analytical fallacies
Re-analysing data to quantify the correct answer
Identifying claims that do survive scrutiny
Writing a constructive, actionable audit for an executive

assessments.title: The Fuel Queue: Simulating a Filling Station During Scarcity
assessments.summary: Derive the M/M/c results, build and validate a queue simulator, estimate demand from a filling-station log with balking, and decide how many pumps to staff when the exponential textbook model is quietly optimistic.
competencies: Deriving M/M/c steady-state results from birth-death balance equations
Implementing and verifying a discrete-event FCFS multi-server simulation
Validating a simulator against analytical results
Output analysis for autocorrelated simulation series (warm-up, batch means)
Input modelling from operational logs, including censored demand (balking)
Separating simulation uncertainty from input uncertainty in a decision

assessments.title: How Sure Are We? Bootstrap and Analytical Intervals Under a Coverage Experiment
assessments.summary: Implement t, Wald, Wilson, exact and bootstrap (percentile, basic, BCa) intervals from scratch, test their 95% promise with a Monte Carlo coverage experiment, and report honest intervals for a skewed, rare-event survey of POS and mobile-money agents.
competencies: Implementing and deriving analytical intervals for means and proportions
Implementing the nonparametric bootstrap and the jackknife from scratch
Designing Monte Carlo coverage experiments with their own error bars
Comparing interval methods across regimes and choosing one with evidence
Communicating uncertainty to a non-specialist decision-maker

assessments.title: Collision Course: How Long Must a Booking Reference Be?
assessments.summary: Derive and stably compute birthday-problem collision probabilities, verify them by simulation, use two days of BRT booking references to show the generator's real code space is about 50 times smaller than designed, and recommend a reference length and design.
competencies: Deriving collision probabilities with indicator variables and linearity of expectation
Numerically stable computation of tiny probabilities
Verifying probability formulas by Monte Carlo with stated tolerances
Estimating a hidden population size from coincidences with an exact Poisson interval
Designing tests for excess coincidences against a stated design
Turning collision and guessing risks into an identifier-design requirement

assessments.title: The Truth Behind the Chart: Forensics of Misleading Graphics
assessments.summary: Audit a gallery of published charts against an exact defect policy (truncated bars, dual axes, cherry-picked windows, area distortion, misleading colormaps, inverted axes, missing sources), compute Tufte's lie factor, and redraw each chart honestly as an inspectable matplotlib Figure.
competencies: Mapping visual channels (length, position, area, lightness) to the quantities they encode
Computing and interpreting Tufte's lie factor
Distinguishing legitimate emphasis from distortion (zero baselines, rank axes, windows, log scales)
Converting sRGB to CIELAB and auditing colormap lightness profiles
Building honest redraws whose properties are verified programmatically
Writing honest headlines and neutral critiques of published graphics

assessments.title: Honest About Uncertainty: Interval Plots, Quantile Dotplots and Fan Charts
assessments.summary: Build a tested library that turns survey estimates and quantile forecasts into honest displays (Wilson interval plots, threshold-aligned quantile dotplots, nested fan charts), refuse incoherent forecasts, and write a one-page market bulletin for a maize-storage decision.
competencies: Computing Wilson intervals and explaining Wald failures at small n
Building quantile dotplots with threshold-aligned bins and frequency framing
Building nested fan charts from quantile forecasts
Detecting and repairing crossing quantiles without silent fixes
Verifying chart geometry programmatically
Writing decision-oriented, non-prescriptive uncertainty communication

assessments.title: Hot Days, Six Cities: A Small-Multiples Climate Story from NASA POWER
assessments.summary: Parse real NASA POWER reanalysis data for six Nigerian cities, compute hot-day indicators under fixed and city-relative thresholds with explicit missing-data rules, and tell an honest small-multiples story about whether hot days are becoming more common.
competencies: Parsing a real scientific data product with a header block and fill values
Defining climate indicators with explicit threshold and completeness rules
Comparing periods and refusing unsupported comparisons
Designing small multiples (ordering, shared scales, annotation) verified programmatically
Writing an evidence-led visual story that states data limitations and avoids attribution claims

compute.notes: About 1.5 MB downloaded once from the keyless NASA POWER API; a free Colab/Kaggle notebook can do the fetch step.

assessments.title: Feeder Hours, Out of Core: pandas vs Polars vs DuckDB on Smart-Meter Data
assessments.summary: Compute feeder supply hours and tariff-band compliance from 8 million synthetic smart-meter readings four ways (pandas baseline, chunked pandas, Polars, DuckDB) with identical results, then benchmark time and memory under an 8 GB-laptop budget and recommend a tool for a DisCo team.
competencies: Out-of-core and partition-aware pipeline design
Lazy query plans and embedded analytical SQL
Exact cross-engine equivalence testing
Benchmark design with fresh processes, repeats and peak-RSS measurement
Mechanistic explanation of performance differences
Evidence-based tooling recommendation under constraints
Validity and sensitivity analysis of a derived metric

compute.free_alternative: Google Colab or Kaggle free CPU notebook (state the RAM available in the report).
compute.notes: About 2 GB of free disk for the generated benchmark set and any converted copy.

assessments.title: The Polite Collector: Ethical, Change-Aware Collection from a Public Procurement Portal
assessments.summary: Design and build a web collector for a mock state e-procurement portal that honours RFC 9309 robots rules, crawl delays and the terms, detects amendments and withdrawals cheaply with conditional requests, raises schema-drift alarms instead of writing nulls, and is measured against a naive baseline.
competencies: RFC 9309 robots semantics and crawl-delay compliance
Turning terms of use into design requirements
Crawl scoping, URL canonicalisation and request budgets
Change detection with conditional HTTP and sitemaps
Schema-drift detection that protects stored data
Data minimisation for personal data under NDPA 2023
Measured comparison of collection strategies against a baseline

compute.notes: All work runs against a local mock portal on a virtual clock. A real-site pilot is an optional extension.

assessments.title: Rain, Grain and Granularity: Fusing Open Climate, Crop and Development Data at Mismatched Scales
assessments.summary: Acquire NASA POWER daily climate, FAOSTAT national crop statistics and World Bank indicators for Nigeria, align them with tested rules for seasons, coverage, flags and trends, and compare at least four alignment designs against a baseline to show how robust any climate-yield conclusion really is.
competencies: Reproducible multi-source acquisition with manifests
Temporal and spatial aggregation with coverage accounting
Flag-aware use of official statistics
Sensitivity analysis across alignment designs against a baseline
Bootstrap uncertainty and honest null-result reporting
Source independence and metadata critique

compute.notes: Downloads total under 10 MB. Tests use small recorded fixtures and run offline.

assessments.title: Same Patient, Two Registers: Probabilistic vs Deterministic Record Linkage
assessments.summary: Link a primary health centre register to a general hospital register with no shared ID. Build a deterministic baseline and a Fellegi-Sunter linker with blocking, compare them on the precision-recall trade-off using a clerical sample, and recommend an operating point.
competencies: Standardising heterogeneous registers for linkage
Blocking design measured by pair completeness and reduction ratio
Fellegi-Sunter comparison vectors, m/u probabilities and match weights
Parameter estimation by EM and from a clerical sample
Threshold and clerical-review band selection
Fair comparison against a deterministic baseline with uncertainty
Linkage error analysis
Privacy safeguards for health-data linkage

assessments.title: The Feed That Breaks: A Data Contract and Validation Framework for a Partner Feed
assessments.summary: Design a data contract and a contract-driven validation framework for daily agent-banking deliveries from a partner: schema, semantic, freshness, volume and distribution checks, row and delivery quarantine, calendar-aware baselines and alerting, judged on unseen sequences.

Contract-driven schema and semantic validation
Freshness, duplicate-delivery and manifest checks
Calendar-aware volume and distribution baselines learned from trusted data
Row-level versus delivery-level quarantine

assessments.title: Rain Before the Price: Multi-Source EDA of Rainfall Anomalies and Food Prices
assessments.summary: Explore 12 years of state rainfall, staple prices and national macro shocks across 18 Nigerian states (synthetic, stylised). Isolate local rainfall signals from national inflation, search lags without fooling yourself, control the false discovery rate, beat a naive baseline and deliver a hypothesis register.

assessments.title: Small Schools, Big Swings: Empirical Bayes for School Pass Rates

Empirical Bayes estimation by marginal likelihood
Covariate-informed priors and diagnosing prior misspecification

assessments.title: The 25-Year Storm: Extreme Value Analysis of Rainfall for Drainage Design
assessments.summary: Estimate 25- and 100-year one-day rainfall for culvert design from a 44-year gauge record with outages and clustered storms, using GEV and peaks-over-threshold models with calibrated uncertainty, and decide what a weakly detectable trend means for a 40-year design life.
competencies: Fitting GEV and GPD models with correct parameter conventions
Return levels with calibrated uncertainty intervals
Threshold choice, declustering and sensitivity analysis
Testing and modelling non-stationary extremes, including power analysis
Turning a statistical estimate into a design recommendation under uncertainty

assessments.title: One House Style: An Accessible, Regression-Tested Chart Style System

assessments.title: The Garden of Forking Paths: A Multiverse Study of Cleaning Choices
assessments.summary: Specify the space of defensible cleaning and analysis choices for a messy three-round panel evaluating solar mini-grids' effect on village enterprise revenue, run every universe reproducibly, attribute variation to decisions, and report how robust the conclusion is.
